temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. Gary declines Ethan's invitation to a weekend retreat, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated, hardworking friend and doctor, but he had not yet fully recognized how serious Gary's work habits had become.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan's general awareness and concern become a specific belief that Gary is dangerously overworked and overly committed to the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is seriously overworked and at risk of health problems, and that Gary's hospital obligations are making him resistant to taking a break.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and disappointed that Gary refused help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene further, encourage Gary to rest, and find another way to support his health without pushing too hard.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan sees Gary acting restless and avoiding discussion of work. Gary tells him the situation is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was overworked mainly because of hospital demands and needed relaxation, though he may have suspected Gary was not fully opening up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan's suspicion grows that Gary's overwork is not only professional but involves hidden personal burdens.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes there is more to Gary's behavior than work obligations; Gary is dealing with something complicated and may be hiding personal problems.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently and nonjudgmentally, encourage him to open up, and offer help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he is facing. He accepts Ethan's offer to help organize his schedule.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspected Gary was concealing deeper issues beyond ordinary hospital work but did not know the specific causes.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now understands the concrete pressures and personal challenges behind Gary's overwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overwork stems from new department responsibilities and personal challenges, and that Gary is willing to accept help to improve his balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and create a healthier work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in with Gary and hears about his progress and remaining challenges. Gary says he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had begun working toward better balance with his support, but he was not yet certain how well Gary was sustaining the change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan's cautious belief is confirmed and strengthened: Gary is making genuine progress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is improving, less overwhelmed, and benefiting from the support and strategies they discussed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering encouragement, and helping Gary manage remaining challenges.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and feels more in control. Gary thanks Ethan and says he could not have done it without his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had made significant progress but might still need occasional support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now believes Gary has achieved a stable, healthier balance and can manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is capable of maintaining his progress on his own and no longer needs regular intervention.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage independently while remaining available if Gary needs him.
